dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped configurations located on the dorsal-lateral surface; these features exhibit sharp, high-intensity light perimeters that transition abruptly from the darker exterior fur to a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Significant density of low-intensity (dark) solid spots lacking internal gradients, primarily clustered along the mid-to-lower flank and becoming more concentrated and smaller in diameter near the cranial region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' rings on the mid-dorsal surface form an irregular quadrilateral; a distinct linear arrangement of three dark blobs exists posterior to the pectoral flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Five highly reflective, high-contrast claw tips visible on the protruding pectoral flipper; localized specular highlight within the ocular boundary.
